summary: AIHubMix advertises 50 models at $0/M input and output, but a firsthand test found that an account that has not been recharged can only try the free resources 10 times. The provider's message says the free quota can be increased after recharging, so this catalog is archived as not worthwhile for genuinely free use.
claim_steps: Open AIHubMix's free-model catalog at https://aihubmix.com/models?filter=free.
Without a recharge, an account can try the free resources only 10 times.
Increasing the free quota requires recharging; this limitation is why the offer is archived.
